title: Nodes (administration)
explain: You see that nodes exist, who owns them and their state, never what is on them. Each action asks for the node's name and a fresh second-factor code.
reasonShared: The reason is shown to everyone who can see the node.
emergencyWarning: This opens a 30-minute session with the node's administrator rights. Its owner is told at once, with your reason, and keeps the list of what you do.
strip-creation: Remove the right to create nodes
newOwner: New owner (type the start of the user name)
warn.disconnect: The worker is revoked and disconnected. The owner has to enrol a new one. Nothing changes on the node.
warn.delete: The node is hidden for everybody and its worker is cut. It can be restored for 30 days. Nothing changes on the node.
warn.purge: The node is erased from Armadok for good: its members, rights, probes, schedules and backups records. This cannot be undone. Files on the node itself are not touched.
warn.take-over: The current owner loses every right on this node and the person you choose becomes its owner, with full access to it. This is recorded with your reason.
warn.ban-owner: The owner's account is disabled and all their sessions end. Their nodes are not touched. An administrator cannot be banned this way.
warn.strip-creation: The owner can no longer create nodes. The ones they already own stay as they are.
